payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute prefix/suffix max and min arrays via 1D recurrences, then for each j combine left and right extrema to maximize p*a_i + q*a_j + r*a_k.
payload.rationale: The solution builds prefix/suffix arrays using simple 1D DP (e.g., pref_max[i] = max(pref_max[i-1], a[i])). This efficiently solves the constrained triple maximization without 2D state.
